title: elastic pipeline + speculative decode (bonus)

design.architecture: A' dual-path: main feed (sync_feed/spec_feed into stream 0) + private draft side-stream (draft_t: own conv cbufs, attn KV shared by pointer copy); d1 uses pending known token, d2..dk re-feed draft tokens
design.conv_state: cbuf shift-register is non-idempotent -> cvsnap: per-layer conv snapshots keyed pos&7 (cvs_pos tag array), restore before draft on rejection, drop only rejected suffix
design.verify: Leviathan/Chen rejection sampling; kp=1 path bit-identical to plain
design.auto_d8: probe plain vs spec, spec needs acceptance >= 0.40 AND >= 10% probe speed win, else plain

precheck.tool: p3_precheck.py (dff 400/396/392, dhead exported INSIDE model file)

candidates.verdict: FAIL - over budget by 4150 B once dhead (29888 B) included
CHOSEN - max capacity within budget, slack 6442 B

dhead.structure: RMSNorm + MLP(144,64) residual + RMSNorm + tied wte

g1_speed.rerun_note: first run 1456.3 during box contention, clean re-run

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: ASan WRITE at end of region in cvs_save (slot 1) / OOB read in cvs_restore
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: rt->cvs + slot*cv_bytes(...) advanced cv_bytes FLOATS = 4x byte count
bugs_found_and_fixed.severity: silent heap corruption in every non-ASan plain run (save at ci=1,sl=0 landed exactly at base+55296)

bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: spec_feed pushes kp msgs back-to-back; shared st[0].pos touched by main (spec_feed) and G1 (run_blocks) concurrently
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: pos passed explicitly: cf_blocks(m,s,t,pos,lo,hi,x), run_blocks(G,s,pos,x); call sites use rt->c_pos[sid]/m.pos/pos
rt->quiet gates entire do_gen/do_gen_spec printf; auto prints exactly 2 lines (decision + final run)
all debug prints (E/S/R/BADS/BADSRC/BADR, T1-T8, SETUP) removed after root-cause

auto_d8.note: before margin hardening (avg2 + 0.95 margin) picks were unstable 4/5; ASan run also chose plain

perf_p3_8.box: non-stationary ±20%; interleaved configs, medians within one window; ratios reproduced across two windows

elastic_plain_single_stream_med2.interpretation: flat N2->N4 (0.91), SMT knee at N8 (0.70) - reproduces phase-1 finding: single-stream decode has structural ceiling <=1.1-1.2x at any N (phase1_results.json formula_check); multistream K-sweep (K4 = 2.48-2.90x) is the elasticity proof

perf_p3_8.sweep_caveat: within-spec-config tok_s differences are inside box noise (+-20-40% raw spread); robust signals: (a) acceptance monotonic in tau and kmax, (b) spec/plain = 0.80 reproduced in two independent windows
perf_p3_8.verdict: spec decode is SLOWER than plain on this box (0.80x at best) - matches the spec-theorem warning (expected ~0.91x possible loss) and the plan's risk table (non-blocking); D8 auto keeps it OFF

D1_vocab_8192.evidence: vocab=4096 <= 8192; head read per token stays small

D2_dhead_le_1_stage_8pct.fail_value: depth-3 draft runs 3/6 blocks + head -> measured draft_pct 44.6-47.9% of cycle time, exceeds '1 stage' spirit
D2_dhead_le_1_stage_8pct.consequence: spec throughput 0.80x plain - exactly the slowdown the D2 evidence predicted for fat drafts; D8 catches it; depth knob (d1-d5 acceptance 45-86%) available but depth<=2 cannot reach the D3 60% gate

D3_joint_train_acceptance_60.evidence: LayerSkip recipe joint-trained (no post-hoc); full-val acceptance depth3 = 0.7294 >= 0.60; runtime acceptance at tau0.5 = 0.9656

D4_n_le_8_prefer_24.evidence: N in {2,4,8} tested; N=2/4 recommended, N=8 SMT knee -34% confirmed (phase-1)

D5_uniformity.evidence: N=4 cost max/avg = 1.086 <= 1.10; G3 variance + draft share (draft share recorded under D2)

D6_suffix_only_flush.evidence: cvs_drop(P+rej+2, P+kp-1) + single-token re-feed of ov[rej] (stage_rt.c:700); lossless battery 8/8

D7_confidence_threshold.evidence: conf<tau draft stop (stage_rt.c:670), tau validated (0,1] default 0.5; tau sweep acc 0.742->1.0 monotonic

D8_auto_off.evidence: acceptance < 0.40 -> plain (stage_rt.c:1145) + 10% speed margin (1148); 6/6 correct picks

honest_findings: spec decode net-negative on this box (0.80x plain) - auto correctly disables it; bonus pillar remains non-blocking per plan
single-stream tok/s does not scale with N (structural, phase-1 formula_check); cores buy multistream throughput (K4=2.5-2.9x) and headroom, not single-stream latency
kmax=1 spec path degenerates to plain (acceptance 0 by construction) - guard: kmax clamped [1,8], default 4
box contention is first-order: same config measured 599-1464 tok/s across windows; all claims are within-window ratios
